description: This file declares the SetLogLevelsService class, which manages IPC clients and sets log levels in the Rialto server component. It includes method declarations for handling client connections and disconnections, as well as setting log levels.

classes.name: SetLogLevelsService
classes.description: A service class that manages IPC clients and configures log levels for the Rialto server.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the log levels for default, client, IPC, and common logs.
